DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice do you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒は私宛てですが、中の紙は知らない人の名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒と中紙の名違いを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The envelope is addressed to me, but the paper inside has the name of someone I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the names on the envelope and the enclosed paper differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で書き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not change the writing yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私の回答として出さず、両方を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人回答を保留して両資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not. I will show you both, rather than submit it as my own response.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put your own response on hold and show both documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行元の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the details identifying the issuing organization.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。中の情報をネットへ載せず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行元を示し非公開を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I would like to discuss this without posting the information inside online.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the issuer details and ask to keep the information private. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信の期限もありますが、自分で該当すると決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限と対象判断を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is also a deadline for replying, but I will not decide for myself that this applies to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the reply deadline from deciding whether you are the intended person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を保持してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the documents and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒と中紙を分けずに残し、確認した対応を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原資料を保持し案内を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the envelope and its contents together and ask what action has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the original documents and listen to the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 外の宛名と中の名の相違として担当へ引き継ぎます。書類は改変せずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer this as a difference between the name outside and the name inside. Please bring the documents without altering them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to have a test?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも症状もあるので、検査を買うだけの希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査希望と症状相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but I also have symptoms, so I am not simply asking to purchase a test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a test and also advice about your symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の症状を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your current symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日からめまいがあります。検査の種類を自分で決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状と検査選択未判断を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have been dizzy since yesterday. I cannot decide for myself which type of test I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your symptoms and that you have not decided which test to choose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。知人が受けた検査が私にも必要とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初診と他人検査を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I am not saying that I need the same test an acquaintance had.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your first visit from another person’s test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診療担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can discuss it with the clinician.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず症状を伝え、必要な診療の案内を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診療案内を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would first like to explain my symptoms and receive guidance on the medical care I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give priority to receiving guidance on medical care. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain how to register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の情報と症状の経過を用意し、初診としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人情報で初診を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare my own details and the history of my symptoms. Please register me as a first-time patient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a first visit using your own information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 初診の症状相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。検査内容は診療の案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer you for advice about your symptoms as a first-time patient. Please confirm which tests are appropriate through the clinical guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の充電器と似ていますが、道で拾った別の物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得品と私物の類似を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It resembles my charger, but it is a different one I found on the street.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the found item resembles your own possession. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の物は手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have your own one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家にあります。接続して試す前に届けに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私物所在と未接続を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is at home. I came to hand this in before connecting it to try it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where your own item is and that you have not connected the found one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where and when you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅前で九時です。持ち主は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拾得場所時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Outside the station at nine. I did not see the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State where and when you found it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check its identifying features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏にシールがあります。内容を公開せずここで示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目印を限定提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a sticker on the back. I will show it here without making its contents public.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the identifying mark only to the staff here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will proceed with accepting it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の充電器の紛失としてではなく、拾った物としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得として受付を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please treat this as an item I found, rather than the loss of my own charger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for it to be registered as a found item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拾得物としてお預かりします。本人の私物と混ぜず、拾った状況を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it as found property. We will record how you found it, keeping it separate from your own possessions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about something after moving home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旧住所の郵便受けが撤去されました。届いた物の扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧郵便受け撤去を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The mailbox at my old address has been removed. I would like to ask what happens to mail that has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the old mailbox has been removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転送の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a record of mail forwarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。箱がなくなっただけで転送も完了とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撤去と転送状態を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not assume that forwarding is complete just because the mailbox is gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish removal of the mailbox from the status of mail forwarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届く予定の郵便は何ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場の書類です。発送したかはまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定郵便と発送未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Documents from work. I have not yet confirmed whether they have been sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain what mail you expect and that dispatch has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人にも照会してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check with the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、新住所も直接伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人へ照会と新住所通知する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will, and I will tell them my new address directly as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check with the sender and give them your new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 旧住居の管理者へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you contact the manager of your former residence?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: できます。保管があるか確認し、勝手に建物へ入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理先へ保管を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will ask whether they are holding any mail and will not enter the building without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the property manager whether any mail is being held. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 転送記録、発送状態、旧住所の保管を分けて担当へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss the forwarding record, dispatch status, and mail held at the old address with the responsible staff as separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯を替えました。旧端末にも銀行の通知が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧端末通知の残存を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed my phone. Bank notifications still appear on my old device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that notifications remain on your old device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the old device?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ譲っていません。登録やログインの状態を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧端末保持と状態確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have not given it to anyone yet. I would like to check its registration and login status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you still have the old device and ask to check its status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人操作で画面を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the screen while you operate it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通知を消すだけで登録解除とは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知消去と解除を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume that simply deleting a notification unregisters the device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish deleting notifications from unregistering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話番号は変わりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は同じです。端末だけ替えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号不変を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is the same. I only changed the device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your number has not changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が切替方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will explain how to make the switch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認前に旧端末を渡さず、必要な手順と結果を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 譲渡前に切替結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not hand over the old device before checking. I will ask about the necessary steps and the outcome.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the outcome of the switch before giving away the device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ番号の端末変更として確認します。旧端末の登録と通知設定は担当の案内で整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check this as a device change using the same number. Please follow the staff guidance to deal with registration and notification settings on the old device.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱を分けて贈りたいです。期限は一袋ずつにもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個包装の期限を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to divide a box up as gifts. Is the expiry date also on each individual packet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether each individual packet has an expiry date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the individual packets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋数だけでなく、必要な表示が残るかを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋数と表示保持を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to check not only the number of packets but also whether the necessary labeling will remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the number of packets and whether the labeling will be retained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この品は外箱の表示だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This product has labeling only on the outer box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では箱を捨てて一袋ずつ渡す予定を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外箱廃棄の予定を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will reconsider my plan to throw away the box and give out the packets separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reconsider your plan to discard the outer box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の商品も比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare other products as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 各袋に表示がある候補を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個別表示の商品を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please show me options with labeling on each packet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a product with individual labeling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの表示をご覧ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 材料と期限が読めます。六袋のこの品にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料期限付き六袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can read the ingredients and the expiry date. I will take this product containing six packets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the six-packet product with ingredients and expiry dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 各袋の表示を確認した六袋入りをお選びください。外箱の説明も残してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose the six-packet pack whose individual labels you have checked. Keep the information on the outer box and take that with you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方と離れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you become separated from your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私が聞いた帰り道を友人は知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰路情報が同行者にないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend does not know the route back that I was told about.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion does not have the information about the return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: できます。右へ、だけで伝えず今の位置と案内板名を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 位置と目印で連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than just saying “go right,” I will ask their current location and the name on the information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use your locations and landmarks when communicating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 北の広場で合流できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can meet at the north plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ広場の写真ではなく案内の名前を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合流場所名を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will send my friend the name used in the directions, rather than a photograph of the plaza.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Share the name of the meeting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 東側だそうです。二人とも北の広場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 双方の位置と移動を合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Apparently on the east side. We will both head toward the north plaza.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Coordinate both people’s locations and movements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流後の出口はここです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the exit to use after meeting up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。合流してから同じ出口へ帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流後の同出口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After meeting up, we will leave through the same exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will use the same exit after meeting up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まず北の広場で合流し、この出口の案内を二人で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: First meet at the north plaza, then check the directions to this exit together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物が重いので、別に送って身軽に乗りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物別送で負担軽減を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My luggage is heavy, so I would like to send it separately and travel without carrying so much.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to reduce the load by sending your luggage separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送先と乗車先は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the delivery destination the same as your train destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。荷物は家、私は職場へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送先と乗車先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The luggage will go home, and I will go to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the delivery destination from your train destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送窓口の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the information for the dispatch counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 列車の券で配達も頼めるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券と発送契約を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not assume that my train ticket also allows me to arrange delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the ticket from a delivery agreement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付まで時間がかかる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Acceptance at the counter may take some time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 発車に間に合わなければ次便を選びます。荷物は放置しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付時間を見て次便を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I cannot make the train departure, I will take the next service. I will not leave my luggage unattended.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider the time needed at the counter and choose the next service if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車の経路も案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also explain the route to board the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発送できるか確認してから、持つ荷物に合う経路を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残る荷物で経路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After confirming whether I can send the luggage, I will choose a route suited to what I will still carry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the route according to your remaining luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物の別送先と職場への移動を分けて窓口へ相談してください。荷物は受付まで管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss the separate delivery destination and your journey to work as separate matters at the counter. Keep your luggage under your control until it is accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入する方はどなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who is moving into the municipality?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけです。家の契約は父名義ですが、父は住みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約者と転入者を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only me. The home rental agreement is in my father’s name, but he will not live there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the person named in the agreement from the person moving in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の入居日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the date you actually moved in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の月曜日です。父の契約日とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実入居日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last Monday. It is different from the date of my father’s agreement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the actual move-in date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 所在地の資料を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will look at the documents showing the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。父を世帯の移動対象として記入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父を移動対象にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I will not list my father as a member of the household moving there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not include your father among the people moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の生活状況を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the responsible staff about your current living arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵は受け取り、私が寝泊まりしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在居住の事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received the key, and I am staying there myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the facts of your current residence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 前の住所も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also know the previous address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。契約者、入居者、旧新住所を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人と住所を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will explain separately who is named in the agreement, who lives there, and the old and new addresses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the people and addresses clearly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人一人の入居として担当へ相談を引き継ぎます。契約名義だけで対象者を決めず確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer this as you alone moving in. Please check rather than deciding who is moving based only on the name on the agreement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss changing an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもの預け先がなく、私の診察へ連れて行くことも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保育事情で同伴と変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have no one to look after my child, so I also want to ask about taking my child to my own consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss bringing your child and changing your appointment because of childcare arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 患者はご本人だけですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are the only patient, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。子どもの診察を追加する希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 患者本人だけを明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I am not asking to add a consultation for my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that only you will be a patient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同伴の条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the responsible staff about the conditions for bringing someone along.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 託児の利用が当然にあるとは考えず、可能な方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 託児を決めず条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume that childcare is automatically available. I will ask what options are possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions without assuming childcare is provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 来られる候補日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other days you could come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金曜なら家族が子を見ます。元の予約もまだ残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別日の家族対応を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: On Friday, my family can watch my child. Please keep the original appointment for now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the family childcare arrangements available on another day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check whether a change is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同伴条件と金曜の候補を聞いてから、一つの予約に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件後に予約を一本化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing the conditions for bringing my child and the Friday options, I will settle on one appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Settle on a single appointment after checking the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人受診の同伴相談と日時変更希望を引き継ぎます。結果確認まで元予約を維持します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer both the inquiry about bringing someone to your own consultation and the request to change the date. We will retain the original appointment until the outcome is confirmed.
